title: MFE with MicroService + Jenkins
summary: Micro frontends and microservices you can deploy one at a time.
description: An Nx monorepo with four Angular apps wired by Module Federation, three Spring Boot services, one Postgres, an nginx gateway, and a Jenkins job that rebuilds only what changed. Edit one micro frontend and one container is replaced in about 40 seconds while the other nine keep their uptime.
facts: ~5–10 min cold, ~40 s per single-app redeploy
Node 24, Java 21, Maven 3.8+, Docker without sudo
